clipboard_locator: ClipboardEvent clipboardData; 6.4.1 Reading from the clipboard; processing HTML paste events
clipboard_observation: Where native equivalents exist, paste exposes text/plain, text/html and image/png through clipboardData. HTML paste is a distinct processing path with browser/format and sanitization conditions. The API does not equate a Word-origin paste with a DOCX file.
pandoc_locator: readers registry and getReader at tag 3.12.1
pandoc_observation: DOCX is dispatched to ByteStringReader readDocx, while HTML uses TextReader readHtml; format/extension options are applied separately. DOCX custom-style and track-change tests do not establish clipboard HTML/plain-text fidelity.

materiality_inference: The brief explicitly describes authors pasting from word processors. Failure to distinguish that input route from file conversion leaves required input limitations unresearched. This is a proposal research omission, not a demonstrated paste failure or demand for executing a converter.
negative_inference_boundary: Neither loss in every paste nor incapability of Pandoc, Quarto or WordPress is inferred. Conservative import/preview warnings remain valid.

available_named_mechanism.observation: WordPress raw transforms act on pasted/dropped HTML and apply a content schema to remove or normalize elements/attributes before matching blocks. This available mechanism is distinct from DOCX file-reader behavior and does not prove any particular Word sample retains meaning.
